request.text: Remind me on September 3, 2026, at 9:05 AM Shanghai time to upload the signed internship evaluation before my work-study shift.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for the explicitly stated date, time, timezone, and internship-evaluation task.

semantic_facts: The reminder arguments must preserve September 3, 2026, 9:05 AM in the Shanghai timezone and the task of uploading the signed internship evaluation before the work-study shift.
forbidden_claims: A reminder is scheduled for a different date, rounded time, inferred timezone, or altered task.
The assistant claims successful reminder creation without trusted Capability completion evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A precise wall-clock value is rounded or normalized incorrectly during Capability argument construction.
An explicit timezone is discarded in favor of an unstated runtime default.
